verdict.overall: The biggest change since Sunday is in TSLA and AMD, both up sharply (TSLA +9.5%, AMD +8.4%) and flipping from neutral to opposing in most expiries as their ceiling levels jump higher, making them look stretched for range trades. SPY, QQQ, NVDA and AMAT look steadiest with little-changed, mostly neutral setups, while PLTR, ZETA, APP and AMAT all carry earnings in the next four weeks with pricey options attached. Confidence in calm range trading is softening for the fast-moving names (TSLA, AMD, MU) and holding up better for the index trackers and NVDA.

tickers.TSLA: Since Sunday: weaker - price surged 9.5% to 407, hitting a resistance zone that flipped the nearest expiry to opposing, with the floor near 380 and ceiling near 420 both pushed higher. Earnings already passed; the move looks stretched for a calm range trade.
tickers.AVGO: Since Sunday: weaker for the near term - price jumped 6.4% and the nearest expiry flipped from neutral to opposing, though the 320 floor and 350 ceiling held steady. Trend is still down, so the rally looks unconfirmed by the options setup.
tickers.META: Since Sunday: little changed in scores (still neutral throughout) but price fell 3.5% and the magnet and ceiling levels dropped with it (ceiling as low as 645-680 from 700-730), showing options traders lowering targets in the downtrend.
tickers.AMD: Since Sunday: weaker - price jumped 8.4% and most expiries flipped from neutral to opposing, with ceilings pushed much higher (up to 640). Earnings land November 3, inside this window, and near-term options are pricey - a higher-risk setup.
tickers.MU: Since Sunday: weaker - price rose 5.8% and both the nearest and farthest expiries flipped from neutral to opposing, while ceilings kept climbing (up to 1050). No earnings in this window, but the trend stays down despite the rally.
tickers.PLTR: Since Sunday: little changed overall, price only up 1%, but the nearest expiry flipped from neutral to opposing and the floor dropped to 180. Earnings due November 2, inside this window, with options getting pricey further out, adding risk.
tickers.NVDA: Since Sunday: little changed - price up 3.3% but scores held steady, with only small shifts in magnet and ceiling levels. Earnings land November 17, inside this window, and the farthest expiry stays opposing with pricier options.
tickers.ZETA: Since Sunday: little changed - still mostly opposing, though the 11-06 expiry flipped from neutral to opposing and the floor rose slightly to 31.5. Earnings due November 9, inside this window, and options here are very pricey - a volatile setup.
tickers.AMAT: Since Sunday: little changed - scores stayed neutral across all expiries while price rose 5% and ceilings moved up (as high as 440-455). Earnings due November 12, inside this window, with near-term options pricey - caution into that date.
tickers.APP: No Sunday baseline. Versus the prior scan, price is little changed (+0.8%) with neutral scores throughout. Earnings due November 4, inside this window, and options are very pricey into that date - a higher-risk setup for range trading.
tickers.SPY: Since Sunday: little changed - price up 1.3%, scores stayed neutral, levels barely moved. In GBP (VUSA): nearest floor £106.49, magnet £109.35, ceiling £114.35; by 11-20 floor £107.21, magnet £110.06, ceiling £114.35. Options remain pricey, no earnings.
tickers.QQQ: Since Sunday: little changed - price up 2.4%, scores stayed neutral, levels broadly steady. In GBP (ISUS, rough since it only partly tracks the Nasdaq): nearest floor £79.06, magnet £81.23, ceiling £84.49; by 11-20 floor £78.38, magnet £81.64, ceiling £84.83. No earnings.
